about: The three biggest execution and MCP files (#571). maxLines only goes down (npm run check:hotspots). Modules listed here were split out of the file and must not import it back, and nothing the file imports may import it back (node scripts/check-import-boundaries.cjs). See docs/architecture/execution-module-boundaries.md.
